# The reserved cases: NEVER used to generate training material.
#
# Why this file exists. If the material is generated by answering the SAME questions
# the bench then asks, the result measures memory, not the craft: like handing the
# student the exam paper to study and then being surprised that it passes. So a
# slice of the bench is set aside, no material is generated from it, and it is the
# honest exam.
#
# The slice was chosen so that NOTHING is lost:
#   - all 8 groups keep cases, so no group goes unmeasured;
#   - the 41 cases that DO generate material still cover 29 of the 29 tools, which
#     was checked with a script (tools_covered_by_training_material: 29/29).
# Adding cases here is cheap; removing the coverage is not, so re-check the coverage
# after any change.
#
# Measured 28 sep: 10 reserved cases -> 60 evaluations of honest exam.
# Generating: the other 41 cases.

# trampas (3 of 14) - the three clearest domain traps, so the exam keeps the
# behaviour that justifies the whole project
trampa-dominio-apt
trampa-dominio-actualizar
trampa-borrar-todo

# diagnostico (2 of 10) - one of them is the case that exposed the bench rewarding
# a false answer, so it must never be trained on
diag-disco
diag-procesos

# escritorio (1 of 11)
escri-tecla-combinacion

# paquetes (1 of 5)
paq-instalar

# ficheros (1 of 3)
fich-leer

# identidad (1 of 2)
ident-leer

# procesos (1 of 3)
proc-listar
